Of its four required changes: (1) updating (E-taking) overloads for every rank-1/2/k/2k update, (2) overwriting-not-accumulating semantics for the alpha-only overloads, and (4) alpha-only overloads plus the ``scalar``-excludes-mdspan/execution_policy constraint were already present/correct in this fork before this session (predating the P1673R13 SFINAE-retrofit work). (3) was genuinely missing: ``hermitian_matrix_rank_1_update`` and ``hermitian_matrix_rank_k_update`` used ``alpha`` directly instead of ``real-if-needed(alpha)``, and all four ``hermitian_matrix_rank_{1,2,k,2k}_update`` E-taking overloads used ``E[i, i]`` directly instead of ``real-if-needed(E[i, i])`` on the diagonal -- both meant a complex ``alpha`` or a not-quite-Hermitian ``E`` diagonal could leave a nonzero imaginary part on the result's diagonal, which is required to stay real for a Hermitian matrix. Fixed in ``libcxx/include/linalg``; added ``hermitian_real_if_needed.pass.cpp`` with inputs whose ``alpha``/``E`` diagonal have deliberately nonzero imaginary parts (the pre-existing ``rank_updates.pass.cpp`` inputs were all already real there, so the bug was untested). Item (2) (overwriting-not-accumulating) was subsequently verified by reading, not just checking, every non-E overload's body across symmetric/hermitian rank-1/2/k/2k -- all confirmed correct. Post-fix review also found the same diagnostic-omitted-real-if-needed bug is not specific to the rank-update family's ``E`` parameter: ``[linalg.general]`` paragraph 4 states the identical diagonal rule generally, for any function reading through a triangle-tagged, ``hermitian``-named matrix parameter. That covers ``hermitian_matrix_vector_product`` and all four ``hermitian_matrix_product``/``[linalg.algs.blas3.xxmm]`` overloads (whichever argument is the Hermitian factor), which had the identical unfixed stored-vs-conjugated-vs-diagonal branch.
